findings.evidence: The Refined schema section restates every refined_commands column, including id, session_id, timestamp, model, and command_text, then says the list is verbatim from refined_store.py.
findings.fix: Keep only the columns whose semantics an agent will get wrong (null turn_id dedup, execution_certain, source_confidence, duplicated token/price, inferred_family). Point the rest at refined_store.py.

findings.evidence: The Dashboard section is a UI inventory (filter order, two-line clamp, three chart types, 150ms debounce) rather than a decision the agent must make before invoking the CLI.
findings.fix: Leave visual behavior in dashboard.py. Keep only agent decisions: no opt-out on browser open, dedup before summing, and the classify-then-dashboard sequence.

findings.evidence: The NEVER list has specific reasons, but several items repeat the Cursor, Codex, dedup, and classify sections above it.
findings.fix: Keep the NEVER list as the single statement of those traps and delete the earlier restatements, or drop the repeated NEVER bullets.

findings.evidence: Description covers WHAT, WHEN, keywords (usage metrics, dashboard, Claude Code, opencode, Codex, Cursor, rtk) and a boundary, but starts as a capability statement rather than an imperative trigger.
findings.fix: Use when the user asks about usage metrics, a usage dashboard, how they use their AI CLIs, command history across Claude Code, opencode, rtk, Codex, or Cursor, grep-family invocations by session, or a filterable static HTML view of captured shell commands. Run the local capture-refine-dashboard pipeline and open the HTML dashboard. Not for export, import, or a hosted-database Artifact.

findings.evidence: SKILL.md is 311 lines with no references/ and no scenario that loads the schema, dashboard, or classify detail on demand; the agent always receives the full column list and UI spec.
findings.fix: Move the column glossary, dashboard UI spec, and classify placeholder notes to references/ and gate each with a read condition (schema question, dashboard question, classify request).

findings.evidence: Resolve the entrypoint requires one Bash call and a literal absolute path, but the fifth candidate is the unresolved placeholder $(dirname "<absolute path to THIS SKILL.md>") plus a prose instruction to substitute it.
findings.fix: Replace the placeholder with one concrete checkout-relative command the agent can run unchanged, and state the stop condition when no candidate prints a path.

findings.evidence: No evals/evals.json and no evals/trigger-queries.json. The skill ships runnable code (ai-kit-usage-metrics.py and ai_kit_usage_metrics/), so D7 is the 5/5/5 split: both eval sub-checks score 0.
findings.fix: Add evals/evals.json with realistic casual and precise prompts, an edge case, expected output, and verifiable assertions, plus evals/trigger-queries.json with about 20 queries, 8-10 should-trigger and 8-10 should-not-trigger including near-misses.

findings.evidence: --help prints only "usage: ai-kit-usage-metrics.py {capture|refine|dashboard|classify|run}" with no flag list, examples, or exit-code meanings. classify prints a raw summary; capture and refine emit nothing on success. tests/test_ai_kit_usage_metrics.py does exercise main(["run"]) and the pipeline.
findings.fix: Make --help list each subcommand, its effect, and exit codes, and emit one JSON object on stdout for capture, refine, and classify while leaving diagnostics on stderr.

findings.evidence: The resolution loop's fifth candidate cannot be executed as written, and the body never says what to do when python3 "$TOOLS_PY" run exits non-zero or a capture source prints a failure while run still returns 0.
findings.fix: Give one runnable resolution command and a failure branch: stop and report the missing install when no path prints; on a non-zero exit or a capture[source] failed line, report that source and do not claim the dashboard is current.
